abstract: In recent times, multitenant database systems in Software as a Service (SaaS) paradigm have gained a lot of attention in academics, research and business arena. The reason being, multitenant database systems are advantageous for both SaaS providers and customers (organizations/companies referred as tenants) who uses SaaS applications. By using a single database system to store data of different tenants the providers gain operational and economic benefits. The tenants in turn get access to shared software and database at an affordable cost. However, this scenario leads to several challenges. One of them being, providing tenants dynamic access to computing resources for accessing the database, nonetheless maintaining isolation and service level agreement requirements among different tenants. The presented work proposes a dynamic resource sharing technique for accessing multitenant databases addressing the aforementioned challenge.

articleTitle: Classification of low resolution astronomical images using convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Currently deep machine learningtechniques are widely adopted by computer vision and signal processing communities. Deep learning, in particular, the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), are the most impressive classifiers widely used for image classification in recent years. CNN model allows the machine to learn automatically about the complex image features from its representation, minimizing the need of human experts in feature extraction. Such a hierarchical representation learning of the images makes CNN a more promising model for classification of different kinds of images as compared to the traditional machine learning models. In this paper, one such successful implementation of CNN is performed for classifying low resolution radio astronomical images containing objects like `Radio Halos and Relics', and several other `Point Radio Sources'. For such images, low resolution makes feature extraction a difficult task. Hence, a CNN based classification model proved more efficient in this casegiving a classification accuracy of 88%.

articleTitle: Evaluating the performance of GPS signals acquisition and tracking
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: GPS receiver design is becoming a challenging aspect depending upon the operating environment (Scintillation) of the user. In order to overcome these challenges, a reconfigurable Software Receiver approach is developed through programming that can adapt to its environment. In order to understand the implementation of receiver, the theory and algorithms behind these processes are presented. The performance of GPS signal Acquisition and Tracking is evaluated in mat lab. At the early stage, RF signals are down converted to IF signals and are digitized using ADC. Then signals are processed to obtain navigation message bits, DLL and PLL discriminators outputs. The soft GPS receiver which is been proposed with parallel code phase acquisition algorithm and tracking algorithms are presented in this paper, which provides flexibility of operation.

articleTitle: Power quality enhancement in smart grid by synchronizing SPWM inverter and LC filter
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In present scenario, the use of non conventional energy resources and non linear loads in to the electric grid is being increasing and it has a adverse effect on power quality issues and also energy management. As a result there will be increase in harmonic distortion, frequent switching of load and hence the flicker formation. Power quality plays a major role in smart grid design and operation. The major reason behind this is active participation of consumers in the power sector and increased usage of non conventional energy resources in to the smart grid. This power grid must necessarily overcome the power quality challenges, so as to avoid barriers against introduction of new technology. This paper overviews the power quality problems and presents the controlling scheme using SPWM inverter and LC filters at point of common coupling in order to enhance power quality in the smart grid. The simulation is carried out using MATLAB simulink.

articleTitle: MEMS based intracranial pressure monitoring sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Intracranial Pressure (ICP) is associated with the brain of the body and therefore monitoring of ICP is having a vital role in various diagnostic procedures of patients with head injuries and trauma. Conventionally, invasive methods are used for ICP monitoring which involve surgical procedures. This work proposes a non-invasive, MEMS based capacitive pressure sensor using Capacitive Micromachined Ultrasonic Transducer (CMUT) for sensing increased ICP. This sensor could be useful for neurosurgeons and medical researchers. The MEMS based CMUT is designed using COMSOL Multiphysics choosing dimensions based on the results obtained in mathematical analysis and Genetic Algorithm optimization using GATOOL in MATLAB. The sensor provides a sensitivity of 1 kPa to 2 GPa thus giving a capacitance output of 863 to 1150 fF respectively.

articleTitle: Design of hybrid filter for elimination of current harmonics
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Here in this paper presents the design of Hybrid passive harmonic filter (H-PHF) and Shunt hybrid active power filter (Shunt-HAPF) to compensate harmonic current produced by a nonlinear load. The H-PHF comprises of a tuned shunt passive filter and tuned series passive filter. The H-PHF is impracticable to use for high power applications because the enormous rating of inductor and capacitor are required. In higher power levels Shunt-HAPF has been a useful approach to eliminate the current harmonics. The control technique used for the detection of harmonic current are synchronous reference frame theory (SRF).

Author Keywords: synchronous reference frame theory (SRF) and sinusoidal pulse width modulation (SPWM)

articleTitle: Image encryption based on pixel transposition and Lehmer Pseudo random number generation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: With the increased cryptanalysis, securing multimedia data against different types of attacks is a challenging task. This can be avoided by using multimedia encryption. The paper introduces a unique technique to encrypt images in two-stages using pixel transposition and Lehmer randomization concept. In the first stage, a standard sorting algorithm is applied on pixel of original image. Duplicate pixel values are eliminated to generate initial transposed image. Image pixel position values are used as unique security attribute and are fetched from the image with respect to initial transposed image and are written as text file. The second stage provides an extra level of security to position values (security attributes) and initial transposed image. Security attribute is further secured by encrypting using logarithmic operation and cipher image is produced by swapping pixels of initial transposed image with the sequence of pseudo random numbers generated with the aid of Lehmer Random Number Generator. The size of generated cipher image is several times smaller than that of original image. The analysis shows that the algorithm is resistant to statistical and differential attacks.

articleTitle: Open source implementation of IEEE C37.118-2011 protocol and serial communication interface for an FPGA based phasor measurement unit
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Phasor measurement units are the latest trend in the power grids for wide area monitoring or measurement system (WAMS). Phasor Measurement Units provides various power measurements along with all the phasor values and many other power line measurements such as voltages and their angles, current and their angles, frequency, real power, apparent power, total power, rate of change of frequency, power factor etc for 3 phase power line. The complete setup of PMUs are still costly and complex due to lack of research in the development of cost effective design for PMUs. This paper introduces an open source approach for implementing IEEE C37.118-2011 synchrophasor communication protocol and uses a serial communication interface for data transfer between an FPGA based phasor data processor and Raspberry pi a mini computer as communication server.

articleTitle: Color image enhancement using metamer mismatch through profile mapping
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Fundamental idea of any image enhancement algorithm is to progress the image to produce a better image than the unique one for a particular application. The perception color in an image is of primary significance to humans given that color features enable us to sense the environment, identify objects with pass information. Through color enhancement techniques we can modify image from a lower end out dated hardware image to match the rich features available in higher end devices. Distinctive procedures have been for cross proposed compatibility between low-end and high end imaging devices. The frequent up-gradation of imaging specifications has affected the color quality to degrade resulting in loss of information. In this paper we focus on using metamers for white point balancing for color enhancement. The proposed method is novel for its approach of using metamer mismatch to decide priors which can be used improvising color quality through evaluating ICC profiles.

articleTitle: Design of a D flip flop for optimization of power dissipation using GDI technique
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: It is aimed to present the methodology used for of optimization of power consumed by a D flip flop using gate diffusion input technique using the gate clocking methodology. A further 1.38% optimization is obtained by using this method, of the already optimized GDI D flip flop circuit using D flip flop triggered on single edge of clock. The Gate diffusion technique is used after analyzing a number of D flip flop circuits since it is found to give the lowest power delay product as compared to other CMOS configurations.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of low power mitchell algorithm based logarithmic multiplier
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Multiplication is a significant operation in signal processing but slow and complex leading to high power consumption and area. Digital Signal Processing repetitively uses multiplication to carry out computations. One feasible solution to simplify multiplication is to use Logarithmic Number System (LNS) instead on Binary. LNS method greatly reduces the computation time but with a trade-off in accuracy. However, we can use this approach in DSP in which speedy computation is of greater concern than accuracy. This paper presents a low power logarithmic multiplication approach aimed to achieve faster computation. The hardware implementation involves very primitive components like adder, shifter and counter which consume less power. Further, adiabatic logic is used at circuit level to reduce power consumption. Power analysis is carried out for traditional CMOS logic and Adiabatic logic using Cadence Virtuoso. The proposed fully adiabatic Switch Rail Charge Recovery Logic (SCRL) and quasi adiabatic Efficient Charge Recovery Logic (ECRL) based logarithmic multiplier is proved to reduce power dissipation by a factor of 81.36 % and 33.4 % respectively than CMOS implementation.

articleTitle: Vehicle classification and surveillance using machine learning technique
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Identifying and classifying an enemy vehicle in military defense system is a sometimes-challenging task for an army. So, this paper proposes an automated system to detect a vehicle from the camera and classify it into the right category of tanks and trucks. This paper focuses on the classification of vehicles using HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradients) and SVM (Support Vector Machine) with higher accuracy. So, this proposed system is optimized in a way to gain maximum accuracy possible. This system focuses on HOG and SVM for classification having higher accuracy. The parameters of HOG and SVM are fine-tuned which results into higher accuracy rate. The algorithms are compared with traditional HOG and SVM approach. The accuracy of proposed approach is higher in comparison with traditional approaches.

articleTitle: High speed duobinary modulation in hybrid DWDM with Raman-EDFA hybrid amplifier
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The high speed duobinary modulated signal is tested on the 16×40Gbps DWDM-OTDM hybrid system with Hybrid Optical Amplifier (HOA): Raman and Erbium Doped Fiber Amplifier (Raman-EDFA). It is shown that when 640Gbps high speed duo binary signals are transmitted using HOA, it covers maximum single span of 119km of Pumped Single Mode Fiber (PSMF) with Maximum Nonlinear Duo Binary Limit (MDNL) = 6dBm after which the output rapidly falls to unacceptable levels. An overall gain of > 11 dB is reported for HOA and acceptable output power and signal quality with Q factor >18dB is reported. Further the duo binary hybrid system performance is compared with the standard binary transmission system and the proposed system is compared with current state-of-the art schemes.

articleTitle: Modeling of 4-element planar inverted F-antenna array for 5G applications
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A MIMO antenna array design comprising of four PIFA components has been presented. The arrangement of the four components has been selected after trying various permutations to achieve an optimum isolation and gain among the elements in the array, compared to the existing ones. The main objective of the paper is to minimize the isolation among the antenna array elements without compromising the overall gain.

articleTitle: Efficient key management for dynamic wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The Security Key management technique has wide coverage for problems regarding wsn because a sensor node can be physically attacked by an intruder. Operational necessities and security are proposed in different present schemes of key management. The wsn has been used in various type of dynamic applications, e.g. area and health care monitoring, military surveillance, process monitoring and in dynamic sensor devices. Wireless device networks comprise small sensor nodes with computation capabilities, strained energy and memory. Encryption protocols used for securing data and for communication. Present work proposes the security for communication using protocol certificate less efficient key management in wsn differentiated by node flexibility. A CL-EKM helps efficient key updating when a new node connects a cluster and also provide the key secrecy. The protocol minimizes the wide effect of node compromisation on a security of active communication links by a withdrawal of compromised node. A security analysis of this method introduced effectively in a struggle against a various multihop wireless network.

articleTitle: A hybrid wavelet singular entropy and fuzzy system based fault detection and classification on distribution line with distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a Hybrid Wavelet Singular Entropy and Fuzzy System Based Fault Detection and Classification on Distribution Line with Distributed Generation. The scheme proposed here for fault discrimination ismainlydepends upon the measurement of three-phase current at 25kV bus of distribution line. By the use of DWT;thedetails coefficient are calculated and then the wavelet singular entropy (WSE)of each phase current signals is calculated. The WSE of each phase current are used as input to fuzzy system for classification of fault on distribution line. The simulation study of doubly feeded distribution line system consist of 120 kV, 60Hz source and 9MW wind farm connected to distribution line of 10 km. Simulation study shows that, the developed scheme works accurately for huge number of fault cases.

articleTitle: Semantic desktop search application for Hindi-English code-mixed user query with query sequence analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: With the advancement of technology, the hard disk space in our personal computers is getting bigger. Now a days it seems easy to search the web and get the relevant result than searching our personal computers. This is because of absence of any sort of interconnection between the documents, media files, and rich text present in the PC. It is really tough to create a knowledge graph for the same. In this rapidly growing digitization world, in county like India where we have listed 22 languages in the constitution the task gets even tough. People from different demographic and socio-economic background are expected to adapt to this fast evolving scenario. Under the influence of social media due deep penetration of smart phones and internet, Indian users are taking up to this. If we observe closely the users are more comfortable in typing their native language in Roman script (i.e. English.) In this work we have developed a desktop search application which can also take Hindi-English Code-Mixed user query. Subsequently the query is converted into correctly spelled English words. Then the query is analyzed for inherent sequential continuity and final reformulation is done. Code-Mixing query is frequently observed in social media and search engines especially form multilingual users. We have considered Hindi-English mixed term queries written in common roman script. Secondly, we have also included the query sequence analysis to automate the Query Reformulation process. The user may reformulate the query if he fails to get the relevant result. Here we expect the user to enter the query like text based conversational search system. On the backend, the data on the PC in indexed into the Apache Solr using Apache Tika and other dependency parsers.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of 1-bit full adder using different design techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A fast and power-efficient full Adder plays key role in electronics trade especially performing arithmetic operations in microprocessors, digital signal processing (DSP) and image processing. Full Adder is such a significant element which contributes substantially to the total power consumption of the network. In this paper, 1-bit Full Adder has been designed which is then analyzed. The leakage power consumption has been done in the circuit using different technologies such as 120nm and 180nm. The designed circuit has shown a incredible reduction in the consumed power of 97.8% and an increase of 12.7% in consumed area compared to GDI full adder in 120nm foundry. By using DSCH2 and MICROWIND2 tools, the designed 1-bit complete adder are compared in phrases of leakage power consumption and surface area.

articleTitle: Received signal strength based dispersion of swarm of autonomous ground vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Definition of swarm refers to a group or a collection of similar objects and the interactions between them. Application of this swarm concept in the field of robotics has led to the origin of an emerging robotics field called as Swarm Robotics. In this work, we develop and analyze a RSSI based dispersion algorithm for dispersing a swarm of robots based on received signal strength using wireless communication between the robots. This algorithm finds its application in swarm behavior of Autonomous Ground Vehicles (AGVs) for its effective dispersion in unknown environments for applications such as unknown area exploration, target detection, search and rescue, mine detection and implantation, etc. In this paper we have discussed a new swarm dispersion algorithm based on received signal strength and have demonstrated the concept with the help of Webots robot simulator.

articleTitle: Development of automated technique for vehicle speed estimation and tracking in video stream
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Development of automated system for vehicle speed measurement is main feature to solve the problem regarding to the traffic surveillance system. It is profitable for secure transportation, avoiding the road accidents etc. There are plentiful technologies or methods developed for speed measurement but to moderate drawbacks of earliest methods, in this paper, we are following key steps such as background modeling, foreground detection and vehicle tracking. This paper presents a technique for vehicle speed measurement and vehicle tracking. The vehicle speed is estimated using system based on background modelling whereas Vehicle tracking have been achieved with the help of blob detection through all frames. This system is flexible and extended for other applications. The speed has been calculated by mathematical formulation based on the number of frames, frame rate & distance traversed by vehicle. This experiment was performed on different type of vehicles and different range of speed.

articleTitle: A novel blind approach for image restoration using adaptive kurtosis based deconvolution
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In the process of image formation, the quality of original image diminishes due to atmospheric conditions, imaging system, transmission medium or faulty devices. Major affecting areas like surveillance, drones, medical imaging, astronomy, microscopy, remote sensing, rover etc., are the key motivation behind blind image restoration process. In restoration through blind approach, a prominent challenge is to estimate the Point Spread Function (PSF) of blur image. Hence, an effective technique requires to solve degradation problem and to restrain image obscureness as minimum as possible. A novel technique is aimed in this paper which works effectively on image corrupted by atmospheric turbulence blur. Corrupted image is initially pre-processed to mitigate heat scintillation. This paper also proposes an efficient adaptive kurtosis based blind deconvolution algorithm to restore degraded image sequences.

articleTitle: Wideband gap coupled microstrip antenna using RIS and RIS cavity resonator
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a wideband gap coupled microstrip antenna. FR4 substrate is used to fabricate the micro strip antenna (MSA) and placed 1.5 mm above ground plane which improves the antenna efficiency and its bandwidth. An array of square patches is fabricated on bottom side of FR4 substrate with inter element spacing between them. RIS reduces the coupling between the ground plane and MSA patch and therefore increases the bandwidth of antenna. This MSA with RIS is placed in RIS cavity resonator to increase the bandwidth of the antenna. Parasitic patches are gap coupled to both radiating edges of fed patch of MSA. Dielectric rods are used at edges with air gap between superstrate layer and ground plane. The VSWR is less than 2 is obtained over 4.704-6.512 GHz, which covers bandwidth of 1.8 GHz also provides uniform gain over bandwidth. The overall bandwidth contains 5.15-5.35 GHz ISM, 5.725-5.875 GHz ISM band and 5.9-6.4 GHz C band. The antenna provides VSWR less than 2 dB and greater than 75 % efficiency of antenna.

articleTitle: Obstacle aware delay optimized rectilinear steiner minimum tree routing
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This research work present a method to solve the problem of constructing Rectilinear Steiner Minimum Tree (RSMT) for a group of pins in the presence of obstacles. In modern very large-scale integrated circuit (VLSI) designs, the obstacles, generally blocks the metal and the device layer. Therefore routing on top of blockage is a possible solution but buffers cannot be placed over the obstacle. Modern VLSI design OARSMT construction has long wire length, which results in signal violation. To address this issue, a slew constraint interconnect need to be considered in routing over obstacle. This is called the Obstacle-Avoiding Rectilinear Steiner minimum tree (OARSMT) problem with slew constraints over obstacles. The drawback of traditional OARSMT is that they only consider slew constraint, and delay constraint is neglected. It induces high routing resources overhead due to buffer insertion and does not solve global routing solution. This work presents an Obstacle Aware Delay Optimized Rectilinear Steiner Minimum Tree (OADORSMT) Routing to address the delay, slew constraint and reduce the routing resources. Experiments are conduced to evaluate the performance of proposed approach over existing approach in term of wire length and worst negative slack. The experiments are conducted for small and large nets considering obstacles and outcome shows the proposed efficiency over existing approaches.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a two objective active suspension using hybrid skyhook and groundhook strategy
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a new strategy to improve ride comfort without violating the rattle space restriction is developed. The control proposed combines a skyhook damping with a groundhook damping depending upon the relative suspension deflection. The control law is designed by considering two variable damping coefficients, which are varying according to the function which is dependent on relative suspension deflection. The main purpose of this paper is to have good ride comfort while restricting the relative suspension displacement much below unity. The paper analyses the performance mathematically for a general rough road profile. The system is validated in simulation using MATLAB and by experimental testing on a scaled laboratory setup.

articleTitle: A novel approach for metal detection in food using curve fitting technique
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Food product contamination is a hazard to human health. Therefore, we can see increasing demand for Metal Detectors. To guarantee the safety and robustness of food product metal detectors are used in the food industry to detect any trace element of metal that may have got into the food during the production process. This paper presents a novel method of detecting contamination in food products by using curve fitting on the data set collected from the metal detector provided by the EME Automation, Goa, India. Features such as amplitude and phase were extracted. The curve fitting is done on the data sets through the use of various algorithms/functions. Implementation of the product effect, zero-band tolerance on the data is taken into consideration. Polar graphs approach have been used for the discrimination between the different products. On the basis of these polar graphs, better identification should be undertaken. This is implemented using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Modelling of dual input DC/DC converter for hybrid energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Alternative energy sources like photovoltaic, fuel cell, wind, ultra capacitor, etc., are widely used in many applications such as in hybrid vehicles, micro grids etc. Combining two or more sources effectively, provides reliable power for the required application. Hence, the concept of hybrid energy system arises. In hybridization of energy systems, conventional sources and non-conventional sources are interfaced efficiently to drive the load. Two or more sources can be interfaced using different power electronic converters. Multiple Input DC/DC Converters (MIC) are one of the interfacing circuits used for hybridization of renewable and storage energy sources. In this paper, Dual input DC/DC converter is proposed which is useful in supplying the load from renewable and storage energy sources individually or simultaneously by connecting the two input sources in series. The two input sources to the converter used are photo-voltaic (PV) cell and a lead acid battery. Operation can be based on Buck, Boost or Buck-Boost modes. Using MATLAB/Simulink software, proposed converter is simulated.

articleTitle: Optimizing handover in LTE using SON system by handling mobility robustness
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Prediction of handover and deciding of handover in long term evolution systems is very complicated. Adjusting the parameters to achieve less delay in the handover then we have to compromise with the system performance and user experience. By doing that it was consuming more time and even that was less robust. Because of increased cell number in Long Term Evolution systems the services are provided with higher speed. With the increase in cell number the operating expenditure for managing them also increases. Solution for resolving this problem is by making use of self-configuring and self-optimizing method. From these two techniques self-optimization is well known for reducing operating expenditure. The handover optimization techniques are analysed for the stationary mobility users in the conventional method. The main intention of our project is to obtain better handover performance for mobility robustness. This paper provides an algorithm for adjusting the handover parameters adaptively and automatically. The algorithm considers handover failure that is caused due to the user equipment mobility changes and also an analysis of the user mobility and handover results of the user equipment that are recorded in the database. These results are examined and selected for the next time handover when a user prefers the same mobility route. By doing so this will reduce the number of handover failures and avoids the unnecessary handovers.

articleTitle: Vertically automated rotary parking system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Nowadays, India is progressing drastically. With the changing India parking problem is a major issue in major cities in India. Insufficient space is always been a problems in major cities and in urban area. The vehicles are parked callously on the streets occupying more space. And in current scenario demand of personal vehicles has also increases exponentially. So, the problem of parking is a big concern by increasing vehicle and adding more congestion on roads of India. To overcome this issue various parking system are also available but this types requires more space not cost effective. So, this project is focused on developing a parking system which is fully automatic and in same context required less space and is cost effective such that 12 cars can be parked in a space of 3 cars only.

articleTitle: Design & development of a bone conduction based navigation aid for the visually impaired
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Blind assistive technology has been a significant area of research and development over the last decade. This paper reports the design and development details of a navigation-aid for obstacle sensing and alerting the visually impaired via bone-conduction. This device can detect head-height obstacles, at distances ranging from 0.20 to 3 meters. A microcontroller ATMEGA 328 generates impulses as alert signals for a vibrating actuator, which communicates to the brain through bone conduction. The entire module is designed to be housed in a comfortable headband, which weighs around 300gm and operates at low power with a 400mAh battery. The device was tested on more than 100 visually impaired subjects and the false positives were zero.

articleTitle: Fast Optimal and eXplorative(FOX) sensing and power allocation scheme for non-cooperative cognitive radio networks
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The spectrum sensing is an essential problem in cognitive radio Networks, where secondary users (SUs) need to detect the presence of primary users (PUs) before they use their spectrum. In this paper, we consider two level-sensing and power allocation in hybrid overlay/underlay non-cooperative cognitive radio networks. We split the sensing and power allocation into three phases, “Fast” sensing, “Optimal” sensing and “eXplorative” power allocation. In the first stage, the well-known Energy Detector(ED) provides “Fast” sensing under high signal to noise ratio(SNR), the sensing goes to second stage “Optimal” sensing when a signal is not detected due to lower SNR. This stage provides accurate sensing using Maximum Eigen Detection(MED) method. Finally, the third phase “eXplore” allocates transmit power (overlay/underlay) based on the channel sensing outcome (channel idle or busy). The sensing switches between one-stage and two-stage based on the decision statistics of ED. In our proposed technique, the sensing time does not effectively increase alongside the number of stages, as these stages are Pipelined. Further due to two level detection the probability of detection is considerably increased. The proposed two sensing and power allocation algorithm are analyzed theoretically. The performance of the proposed scheme is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Estimation and tracking of pitch for noisy speech signals using EMD based autocorrelation function algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Pitch is an important parameter in speech processing. It plays a major role in many speech processing applications. Speech signal is affected by background noise and it degrades the performance. Estimation of pitch for noisy speech signal is important task in many applications. This paper includes the estimation and also tracking of pitch using Empirical Mode Decomposition based Autocorrelation Function algorithm is used. Empirical Mode Decomposition is applicable for nonlinear and non-stationary signals and autocorrelation is efficient method for estimation of pitch in noise corrupted signals and as well as noiseless speech signal. Zero-crossing rate and energy based methods are used to separate voiced/unvoiced region. Only voiced region is considered for the estimation of pitch. Experimental analysis and result for different speech signals is explained in detail. This method gives the less computational complexity which is suitable for real time. It also gives the efficient estimation of pitch in speech signal.

articleTitle: On the development of moving object detection from traditional to fuzzy based techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Moving object detection or background subtraction is considered to be one of the active area of research in the field of computer vision. Background subtraction is a key module in moving object detection. It is the process of separating background from the captured frame. The fundamental method of detecting a moving object is to segregate the background from the frames. During object detection, background can be treated either as static or dynamic. However, it is difficult to detect an object in dynamic background due to certain factors like varying in illumination, sudden change in a scene, occlusion, shadow, etc. So keeping this in mind, this paper reviews some of the background subtraction methods in context to moving object detection. Both traditional as well as fuzzy based approaches are reviewed. In most of the observations the traditional based approaches fail to produce a better object detection accuracy in dynamic environment. So fuzzy based approaches are the better alternatives over traditional one. So, a comparative analysis is presented using fuzzy based approach to give a clear insight to the readers about the state of the art of the techniques with respect to moving object detection.

articleTitle: VHDL implementation of novel squaring circuit based on Vedic mathematics
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Squaring operation plays a vital role in almost all fields of signal processing. Usually there are no dedicated units for squaring operation. The usual multiplier units consisting of several shift and add operations is the one which does the squaring operation too. Squaring being one unique case in multiplication itself, implementing a dedicated part for this with a lesser complex circuit would certainly result in better performance altogether. And this paper is dedicated in achieving the same. Here we implement a novel squaring circuit which uses YTVY sutra (algorithm) from Vedic mathematics and importantly no multiplier unit is used in any of the levels for squaring. The circuit is designed with VHDL and synthesized in Xilinx ISE Design Suite.

articleTitle: Development of automated test equipment for ESP controllers
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The complexity of electronic-device testing varies widely, ranging from the simplest type manual testing to the most complex Automatic Test Equipment (ATE). Presently power controllers for electrostatic precipitator at industry are tested using simulators at the E-shop and controller development lab. The simulated inputs and outputs are generated manually through mechanical keys and push button switches. The verification process and documentation are also done manually and hence time consuming. To overcome these disadvantages, an intelligent, multipurpose simulator cum test equipment was proposed. ATE was developed using LPC2378 ARM processor with required input and output channels. The ATE has multiple communication interfaces like RS485, RS 232, CAN and Ethernet. It is also provided with Liquid Crystal Display (LCD), keypad and Local Area Network (LAN) communication. ATE completes the testing of controller without any manual intervention. Upon completion of testing, ATE sends out test reports to any computer connected to its LAN Port. The test report is generated in the form of Hyper Text Markup Language(HTML) pages with time stamping and controller particulars.

articleTitle: Image synthesis using convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The image processing task for conversion of image style is a tedious task. The previous approaches carried out in this area lacked in extracting higher level of abstractions from the input image, hence failed to generate image content from the acquired knowledge. Hence to achieve higher level knowledge from the object to be recognized, we make use of convolutional neural networks which aid in achieving higher quality images. The proposed work uses a Neural Algorithm that produces an image with a new style using the knowledge acquired from input image. Our work provides a new approach for deep representations of images using Neural Networks, hence demonstrating the generation of high level image synthesis and manipulation.

articleTitle: Clustering by feature optimization for static community detection
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Now-a-days the research on community detection is gaining lot of attention. Different applications of these communities are very common in modern days. Most common application appears in social network to build a platform of people sharing common interests in different aspect. This community detection technique is mainly deployed on network structure. This network may be physical one like power grid or a virtual one like Facebook. One of the strongest approaches in community detection is to extract patterns from the behaviour of the participating members and their activities. Task of pattern extraction is commonly done by identifying features. This work performs feature identification and optimization of identified feature to group members of a network into different communities. The work has been experimented on some standard test benches and that produce some good result.

articleTitle: Radial distortion estimation using analytical technique
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Nowadays low-cost wide-angle lenses are extensively used in the fields of computer vision, photogrammetry and image processing to get critical information. However, these lenses provide vast field of view at the cost of significant distortion in the images. Hence, distortion estimation and correction becomes a prerequisite in almost all the fields. A novel approach for estimation and correction of radial estimation has been proposed in this paper. The proposed idea is based on plumb line method of distortion estimation in which no specific information about the camera parameters or scene is required. Straight lines existing in the 3D space are transformed to curves in the captured image. The proposed method determines the coefficient of distortion based on angle formed between these curves. Besides this, a detailed analysis of the effect of shape, size and position of curves is also presented.

articleTitle: A comparative investigation on user's perspective reliability evaluation and prediction of web services
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Sharing and exchanging the abundant information and resources over the internet in a secure and dependable manner through web service is the tricky task. In this paper we have designed and implemented a research prototype web service based e-ATM and medicine searching services in .Net and Java technology respectively. We have performed a relative evaluation on availability and reliability under massive loads for each service. Web service testing predicts the correct and robustness of services before deployment. In this perspective we present a framework of testing the services, statistical analysis over the service metrics for estimation and prediction of availability and reliability of the proposed services.

articleTitle: E-shield: Detection and prevention of website attacks
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: As Internet usage is growing daily the world is coming closer making it a smaller place to live for its users. However, it has also managed to create problems for people because of the increase in cyber-crimes. So there is a need for monitoring and analyzing both user and system activities and thus tracking as well as blocking the malware is a must. This is where intrusion detection system (IDS) and intrusion prevention system (IPS) comes into the picture. IDS and IPS have a substantial societal impact on reducing the number of cyber-crimes and providing a platform to facilitate basic security amenities for small scale firms and budding entrepreneurs. The majority of intrusion prevention systems use the detection methods which include Signature-based, Statistical anomaly-based and Honeypot-based. Using these detection methods, the malware is detected, and then further actions are taken to block the malware. IPS techniques differ in how they scan the data streams to detect a threat or intrusion. Data capture and data control are used by the research community to study issues in network security, such as Internet worms, spam control, and Denial of Service (DoS) attacks. In this paper, we will be focusing on prevention from the attacks.

articleTitle: QR encoded auxiliary information for print-scan channel image recovery
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In most cases auxiliary information encoded from printed photograph is not sufficient to recover the original digital image because of hierarchical distortions introduced during scanning process. The proposed approach can able to overcome this problem by extracting metrics such as color, luminance and spatial frequencies from input image and encoded in separate channel using QR pattern generation which will leads quality in print-scan images with lesser appearance losses. In existing methods Extracted digital auxiliary information is stored by printing it using invisible inks or dense barcodes. In this paper we introduces the concept of color QR images, which has high embedding capacity and easy to embed inside input image with bounded probability of detection error. Here we develop cyan (C), magenta (M), and yellow (Y) QR pattern which is carried along with print colorant scan channels as a three unique QR codes, used for capturing color QR pattern. The proposed technique consists of two main processes namely encoding followed by color QR pattern generation and distortion less QR embedding process. Encoding process generates auxiliary information about input image and it is kept together with the print as a color QR image pattern. Embedding process uses half toning process to increase visible appearance in order to eliminate the distortions introduced during decoding process. Our experimental results proved that the proposed QR pattern based approach can embed detailed information about the digital image with least complex decoding process.

articleTitle: Design of CS-VCO with band gap reference in 0.18μm CMOS technology
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Presently design of a linear and wide range voltage controlled oscillator for analog and mixed mode signal applications with lesser design cycle time is a challenging work for Electronics Engineers. Band Gap reference voltage source is required, since the power supply noise is one of the important factors that affect the PLL noise performance. This paper describes the new design technique of the Band Gap Reference Current Starved Voltage Controlled Oscillator (BG-CSVCO) circuit to reduce power supply noise for PLL application. The BG-CSVCO circuit is designed and simulated using 0.18μm CMOS Technology. The BG-CSVCO has frequency range from 1.59 MHz to 2.87 GHz for the tuning range 0.2V to 1.8V and power consumption is 1.336mW. The supply voltage VDD is 1.8V.

Author Keywords: Band Gap Reference Current Starved Voltage Controlled Oscillator (BG-CSVCO)
analog And Mixed mode Signal circuit

articleTitle: Key frame extraction, localization and segmentation of caption text in news videos
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Caption text detection in news videos has become an important research topic due to its capability of providing more information and thus used to obtain keyword for annotating, summarization, building digital news library. The Key frame extraction method has been proposed which takes into account the pixel difference between 2 consecutive frames. The pixel difference will be less when the same text is present and less motion in the background. Further uniform edges present in the text region are used to differentiate them from frames having same background. Using this method 1.0 precision has been achieved. Text localization is done using the method of merging the text region horizontally and using projection profiles. 0.92 precision has been achieved. K-means algorithm performs better when text has complex background. The cluster size used is 3 and cluster having the segmented text is automatically detected and achieved an accuracy of 95.4%.

articleTitle: Role of source separation using combined RPCA and block thresholding for effective speaker identification in multi source environment
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Speaker Recognition is the technique used for validation of a user's identity by extracting certain features from his/her voice. This method is the most utilitarian one amongst the different biometric based recognition methods. Efficiency of speaker recognition system falls under noisy multi source environment like background noise and music. This paper uses an efficient front-end processing system to improve the performance of speaker identification in multi-source environment. In this work RPCA (Robust Principal Component Analysis) algorithm is used on mixed speech signal to separate the musical background from the signal. Other background noise is then removed using block thresholding algorithm. The separated speech from the mixed signal is then used as input for effective speaker identification.

articleTitle: Design of asymmetrical coupled line interdigital filter for long term evaluation (LTE)-26 band
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Filters are key components in RF transmitter and receiver sections. The purpose of this paper is to design a asymmetrical coupled line inter digital filter for Long Term Evaluation (LTE) band 26, having uplink from 814MHz to 849MHz. Design principle of proposed filter is based on even and odd mode coupling nature of asymmetric microstrip coupled lines. Dimensions of the filter play an important role in RF front end design. The asymmetrical coupled line inter-digital design reduces the dimension as compared to other filter designs, such as microstrip coupled line filter. This approach also reduces the cost of fabrication due occupation of smaller footprint as compare to coupled line bandpass filter. This asymmetrical coupled line inter digital bandpass filter provided good stop band attenuation which is about -20dB at ± 20MHz of cutoff frequency. The proposed filter is implemented using FR-4 substrate having ϵ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> = 4.4 height =1.6 mm. The obtained results of simulation show insertion loss of 2dB (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub> = -2dB), return loss of 15 dB (S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> = -15 dB) and ripple of 0.1dB. The filter shows good response for passband frequencies.

articleTitle: A survey on human motion capturing (HMC) system based on distributed computing technology with flexible architecture
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The evolution in people and technology over a period of time has resulted in the current day situation where based on the posture of the human being, the probable diseases to which he is prone can be predicted. In present day scenario where applications involving healthcare sectors, military sectors to entertainment sectors, the detection and recognition of human movements and gestures has become more prevalent than before due to its widespread applications. The applicability of posture detection system is realized using the Human Motion Capture (HMC) system. To better understand the features of HMC, In in this paper a general working of a HMC system is given, consecutively, a brief review of literature along with the research methodologies and techniques are provided for each stage constituting the HMC system. The research gap and the future scope of the HMC system is also mentioned with corresponding research challenges.

articleTitle: Analysis of MAODV MANET routing protocol on different mobility models
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: MANET is an infrastructure less network. It has various applications in fields like military, commercial sector, local level, etc. MANET is easy to setup, configure and build. Due to infrastructure less network, MANET relies on the cooperation of nodes for communication. In MANET, communication between the nodes is possible with the help of protocols which are categorized into three types like reactive, proactive and hybrid. In the reactive category of protocol, a path is established at the real time. In the proactive category, protocols have predefined routing tables for each node. The hybrid category is the combination of both these categories. Modified Ad-hoc On-Demand Distance Vector (MAODV) is the reactive protocol which defines all possible routes among source node and the destination node which are maintained during data transmission. In the case of a disappointment of definite route, the data packets are transferred through secondary routes which were established with the help of routing tables that stores the multiple route paths to the destination. In the real world, nodes in MANET are allowed to transfer in any direction. Thus movement models like Random Way Point (RWP), Random Walk (RW), Random Direction (RD) and Gauss-Markov (GM) are taken as they have different mobility patterns. Therefore, M-AODV is implemented over different mobility models to compute parameters like End to End Delay (E2E Delay), Average Hop Count (AHC), and Throughput.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of different architectures of montgomery modular multiplication
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The Montgomery multiplication is the main block of modular exponentiation in cryptography. This paper discusses the three different architectures of Montgomery Multiplication and their performance is compared in terms and area and time optimization. The architectures are designed to improvise the area and reduce time. The designs are implemented in Verilog HDL and simulated using Synopsys VCS. They are also synthesized in Synopsys Design Compiler using 45nm libraries to get the cell area. The experimental results show that the time required for one Montgomery multiplication measured in terms of number of clock cycles is reduced by 1.5%, 1% and 3.5 % for the three different architectures discussed here over the previous implementations. It is achieved by minimizing the signals controlling the critical path of the design. Also there is a reduction in total cell area due to technology for the three designs presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Hardware realization of fuzzy logic driven PWM controller for a cold storage system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Diverse agro-climatic conditions and vast production base in India ensures large producability making the country second largest producer of fruits and vegetables in the world. However, the huge potential available in the nation in the form of export opportunities is not effectively tapped as one third of these produces get deteriorated in post-harvesting. Further, the post-harvest losses affect the per-capita availability of fruits and vegetables and results in high marketing cost, market gluts and price fluctuation. Lack of proper cold storage and cold chain facilities in the country are the major bottlenecks causing the post-harvest losses. Previous research works on cold storage system emphasize the need for monitoring all the essential parameters and demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of using fuzzy logic for controlling these parameters through MATLAB simulation. Hence, it is planned to design and implement an intelligent fuzzy logic driven PWM controller for a cold storage system to control the required parameters. The controller module is designed, implemented in hardware and tested.

articleTitle: Seclogmon : Security in cloud computing using activity log for consumer data protection
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Cloud security encompass under its umbrella very extensive set of service level agreements (SLA's), methodologies which are used to secure user data, applications and resources that are connected via cloud. But, still the clients are handicapped with very little support and knowledge about what actually happens to their data after they have pushed it on to the cloud. Data ownership is important issue, especially while dealing with an enormous amount of data. This allows cloud provides to create their own terms and conditions, which at times may seem arbitrary. We proposed a novel approach which will maintain logging and monitoring for helping cloud consumers to identify any abnormal activity and resolve the problems accordingly. But, logging has a wide application too, therefore it depends on the user how and what he logs and monitors. To aid the consumers all cloud service providers maintain logs and generate a huge amount of information, much of which is redundant, awkwardly formatted, but there are hidden clues that can help the consumer to understand that they are having, or more importantly, about to have a problem. Using these logs the work creates a tool which parses these logs and provides user the apt amount of information and allows them to understand their activities and job behavior on cloud. It helps them to report any anomaly in the use of their cloud job and infrastructure effectively.

articleTitle: Maximum-minimum energy detection for spatial spectrum sensing
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Spectrum sensing is an important techniques used in cognitive radio system which provides the knowledge of spectrum occupancy and also the activities of the licensed user. Energy detection technique depends upon the information of noise power and encounters the problem of noise uncertainty. Here, blind spatial method for spectrum sensing is used to overcome the noise uncertainty problem. An Electronically Steerable Parasitic Antenna Receptor (ESPAR) has been used that is able to distribute the space into various sectors. Moreover, the received beam pattern can be switched to individual sectors. The existence/non-existence of the licensed user signal depends upon the difference of the energy of the received signal in sectors. The maximum-minimum energy ratio is used to find out the existence/non-existence of the licensed user in a blind energy based algorithm. To remove the noise uncertainty issue and to improve the reliability with low complexity maximum-minimum energy detection (MMEN) sensing method is used. Simulation result indicates that as we increase the number of sectors, probability of detection increases. The reason behind this is that the signal strength depends upon the angular spread. Hence, when the angular spread increases, signal strength also increases which allows the number of sectors to be increased. Therefore, increasing the number of sectors, increase the detection probability.

articleTitle: FPGA based design of hierarchical self-test for surveillance system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper describes various measures that have been taken to facilitate self-test of surveillance system. The structure and working of hierarchical self-test at system level, subsystem level and chip level is presented. Experiments are performed to verify the design and the results suggest that the proposed system is able to isolate and diagnose the faults of a complex system such as surveillance system.

articleTitle: Throughput performance analysis of an integrated mobile WiMAX — DSRC cellular network with adaptive modulation and coding technique
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Access to the Internet has become a predominant activity within our everyday life. So, new advanced broadband technologies are required for delivering high quality multimedia applications to the customers with high speed and elevated reliability. Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access (WiMAX) is one among the competing technology in present circumstance to offer broadband facility with high-speed data access. But the overhead issues with this technique due to huge number of control signal exchange prevents it in gaining popularity in services like vehicular communication. In recent time, Dedicated Short Range Communication (DSRC) is an emerging technology for short range vehicle-to-vehicle communication. So for long distance vehicular communication, the integration of WiMAX and DSRC technology can be an efficient approach. In this paper, an Integrated WiMAX-DSRC cellular network is proposed in which clustering technique is applied in enhancing the throughput of the users. The performance metric taken here for analysis is the throughput of the system and its expression is derived. Also, the effect of varying different modulation and coding scheme (AMC), uplink/downlink subchannel ratio and uplink/downlink symbol ratio on the performance metrics are elaborated.

articleTitle: To provide an easy and fast means of identification of blood group using IR sensors
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Identification of blood group plays a vital role in the medical field for any treatment. Miss-transfusion of blood will lead to many complications. This method provides an easy and fast means of identification of blood groups. The difference in the amount absorption by each blood group is exploited so as to categorize the blood groups. The light from the pulsating IR LED is passed through the blood sample and the transmitted light is then detected, conditioned and is converted into voltage signal. The variations in the intensity of the received signal due to the absorption of blood for different blood groups are translated into corresponding voltage changes, to classify the blood groups.

articleTitle: Outage analysis of a multihop cognitive network with energy harvesting from a primary cluster
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the performance of a multi-hop cognitive Decode Forward (DF) relaying network in terms of secondary outage probability (SOP) and secondary throughput. All the secondary nodes are energized by the energy harvested from the RF signal of a cluster of Primary Transmitters (PTs). The analytical expressions for harvested energy of the secondary nodes (including secondary source (SS) and secondary relays (SRs)), secondary transmit power are derived. The SOP and the throughput of the secondary network are derived, considering different number of hops and underlay cognitive constraint. Optimal number of PTs has been estimated for several number of hops.

articleTitle: Implementation and comparison of echo cancellation algorithms using adaptive filtering techniques in TMS320C6748 DSK
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Acoustic echo is an unwanted signal where, delayed and distorted speech signal is reflected back to a source. Echo generation is a common occurrence in mobile communication system. Signal interference is caused by an echo which disturbs the users. Due to this signal quality in mobile communication is reduced. So, adaptive filtering techniques are used to suppress the echo. This intern results in enhancing the signal quality in mobile communication system. In this paper various types of adaptive filtering techniques namely, Least Mean Square, Normalized Least Mean Square, Recursive Least Square algorithm in Matlab® / TMS320C6748 DSK are implemented. Performance parameter like Minimum Square Estimation, Echo Return Loss Enhancement, Signal to Noise Ratio and computational time are measured and compared for the above adaptive filtered algorithms.

articleTitle: Type-2 fuzzy logic control for airlane monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper describes about a decision system for air-lane monitoring. An automatic controlling system is developed in aircraft to handle a situation where it is very hard to take a right decision for pilot. In order to resolve this issue a new fuzzy type-2 logic system is developed, which is proposed in this paper. An air-lane scenario is taken and implemented the new type-2 Fuzzy Logic system. Earlier developed Type-1 fuzzy logic system was not able to handle this scenario precisely. An overview of both type-1 and type-2 fuzzy system is presented here. In type-2 fuzzy system four parameters: distance, bearing, class and altitude are considered to compute the output matrix, based on the matrix system takes a constant decision. The computation is based on Mamdani inference method. Implemented fuzzy logic system gives a better result in terms of uncertainty handling and robustness. This is proved in our result section.

articleTitle: Modelling and comparison of Si-MOSFET and eGaN-HEMT for power converter applications using TCAD
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Enhancement mode gallium nitrite HEMT (High Electron Mobility Transistor) devices are a new generation power switches in the field of power electronics. In this article, Si-MOSFET and eGaN-HEMT has been modelled and simulated. By improving the drain current and breakdown voltages of the eGaN HEMT over the Si MOSFETs, can be allow to operate at higher voltage ratings. In this article, eGaN-HEMTs structure is modelled and also simulated the electrical characteristics. The analysis was made in terms of I-V curve and also plotted the breakdown voltage of the devices. The breakdown voltage, on-state resistance and threshold voltage is analyzed. The modelling and characteristics of eGaN HEMT and Si MOSFET are performed using Sentaurus TCAD tool.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of compact printed circuit antenna for wireless medical telemetry service
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A compact printed antenna with a spiral winding, an inverted-F configuration and a microstrip feed working in the WMTS (Wireless Medical Telemetry Service) band (608–614MHz) is proposed. The construction of proposed antenna is done on a low-cost FR-4 material with a thickness of 1.6mm and ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>=4.3. Proposed antenna has a compact size of 37×20 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> including a ground plane. Antenna is simulated using CST MWS software and it is evident from the simulation results that the presented antenna resonates at 610MHz, has a bandwidth of 9MHz with S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf><−10dB, a peak realized gain of −11dBi with omnidirectional radiation pattern and a 50ohm impedance without any additional matching network.

articleTitle: Testing and validation of UART using cloud based GUI
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Setting up of a communication protocol between two electronic devices is of vital importance in any embedded system. Testing and validation of such a protocol would imply the proper functioning of the system. In many scenarios mobility and distance between the System Under Test (SUT) and the test engineer is an impediment to be considered. The solution to such a problem is wireless testing. The Objective of this paper is to develop a wireless system for communication protocol testing and validation. The end product includes a test device consisting of probes for real time signal probing and measurement along with a Cloud supported web application with Graphical User Interface(GUI) for displaying the signals. The hardware board was able to sample the signal at a maximum of 400 kilo samples per second and was able to publish the data with a depth of 512 bytes on the MQTT (Message Queue Telemetry Transportation) broker which forwarded it to the cloud. To implement the system TI-CC3200 Simplelink Wi-fi board along with IBM bluemix cloud based Node RED application were used. This testing and validation of signals using cloud based GUI can be extended to many industrial and medical applications for real time signal probing and measurement.

articleTitle: Comparative study of methods to determine fractal dimension
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The paper focuses on detection of branch retinal vein occlusion as it is the most common type of occlusion seen leading to sudden vision loss. A novel method of Fractal Analysis is used for analysis of this disorder. This paper focuses on comparative study of methods to determine fractal dimension. The methods used are mass-radius method and box counting method. The implementation work using mass-radius and box counting method is also discussed along with the algorithm used. The algorithm of mass-radius and box counting method is applied on both normal as well as occluded retinal vessels and the results are obtained for the same.

articleTitle: Functional observer based higher order sliding mode control for DC-DC Buck converter
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The study in this article focuses on the design of functional observer based higher order sliding mode controller for DC-DC Buck Convertor. Functional Observer is used for linear estimation of unmeasurable state variables which are required for the closed loop stability of a dynamic system without unnecessarily estimating all the individual states. The proposed method thus reduces the overall complexity, cost of the system and minimizes the number of individual sensors which are required to measure each state variable of the system. Functional Observer based higher order sliding mode controller is used to obtain chattering free control signal which assures easy practical implementation of the controller when compared to the functional observer based conventional sliding mode controller. The robustness of the proposed observer based controller is tested under input parameter variation and unknown input disturbance.

articleTitle: A particle swarm modelforstatic community detection based on homogeneous features
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Community structured networks are gaining prime importance in recent researches. Membership of these networks represents some meaningful information. These networks can be further sub grouped into smaller sub-networks towards efficient management of overall network schema. In some networks these membership patterns often change and that leaves a major impact on the characteristics and behavior of the whole network. In this present work, some of those existing researches have been explored and on the basis of that study a new bio-inspired approach is proposed to identify meaningful sub-networks. This particle-swarm model (PSM) performs community detection in homogeneous network. This method has explored some essential features in community detection. Comparative experimental findings set up novelty of this present proposed research.

articleTitle: Analysis of ICA MIMO-OFDM VLC system with different FOV based photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the performance analysis of ICA MIMO-OFDM VLC system using the number of photodetectors with the same field of view (1-FOV) and two different field of view (2-FOV) has been carried out. Use of MIMO leads to a complex channel matrix and increases the complexity of channel estimation. Independent component analysis (ICA) is applied to reduce the complexity & convert MIMO-OFDM signals into SISO-OFDM signals. Frequency modulator has been further used in this scheme to reduce the peak to average power ratio (PAPR) of an OFDM signal and it also reduces correlation between MIMO-OFDM signals & enhance the separation performance of ICA. Simulation results in 4×4 MIMO-VLC indoor environment show the BER of the scheme is approx 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> level at SNR of 12 dB with 2-FOV optical receivers, which is better than conventional 1-FOV optical receivers. On the other hand, the BER obtained for the proposed scheme through minimum mean square estimation (MMSE) is approx 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> at 12 dB SNR which is better than least square estimation (LSE).

articleTitle: Time series modelling for lifetime estimation of solid state luminaires
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Reliability analysis and estimation plays an important role in optimal decision making for any product, and solid state luminaires are no exception. This paper aims to estimate the reliability of SSL luminaires through statistically designed experiments. Using external data, inferences on the effect of various factors are drawn with the help of statistical models. Time series models have been developed using Wolfram's Mathematica and these models are used for the lifetime prediction of the luminaires at seventy percent lumen output which is also known as L70.

articleTitle: FPGA based hand sign recognition system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The prehistoric or primitive cave men's where communication first existed or started were using a means of sign language or gesture for communicating with each other. With the dawn of time, the man started working tirelessly to make his life better and better. The inventions of new technologies and the computer brought a huge change in the life of people. The Computer and advent of the internet made communication and transfer of information easier. But this is always an interaction with machines. The future era is conceiving of human-computer interaction (HCI) that can be used for implementing 3D applications in which user can move or rotate his hands without any input devices like keyboard or mouse. The communication involving hand gestures or signs for communication forms a basic platform for the proposed system. Many researchers have performed different work by using different algorithms. Some of them even have revised their previous algorithm. The current work and related literature review have given a way of developing a new system that can overcome all the system and should provide the best accuracy. The proposed system involves capture of images and then processing it, then filtering the unwanted part. The further processing of the image is carried out using FPGA, i.e. Field Programmable Gate Array. The system desires to give an excellent simulation, good accuracy, minimizes run time and efficiently reduces the power consumption.
