An effective routing algorithm for a multi-hop cognitive radio network is proposed based on energy detective sensing and routing decision is being made based on the channel quality indicator.

articleTitle: Sensitivity enhancement in piezoresistive micro-pressure sensor using perforated diaphragm
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: MEMS is the science of miniaturization which creates tiny-integrated devices. The piezoresistive pressure sensors because of its high sensitivity and linearity, ease of fabrication is mostly used in wide variety of applications. To enhance the sensitivity of the conventional piezoresistive pressure, the diaphragm is made perforated. The diaphragm in the non-stress area is made porous to reduce the mass of the device. Mechanical stiffness of the perforated diaphragm when subjected to pressure induces more stress comparatively. The pores of size 40μm×40μm are made in the diaphragm of size 400μm×400μm. The percentage of porous area is varied from 0 to 40% and results are compared. The designed models are simulated using COMSOL Multiphysics. The simulated results reveal that Sensor with 40% perforation is highly sensible to applied pressure and shows extended linearity. The sensitivity of the sensor with 40% perforation achieves 49.6mV/V/MPa where as conventional sensor is 42mV/V/MPa.

articleTitle: A knowledge based approach for long answer evaluation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an approach on long answer evaluation using lexical and semantic similarity measure has been presented. The goal of this work is to introduce a system which programmatically evaluates the long answers from the examinee and hence reduce the time and effort of human intervention as well as make the evaluation procedure impartial to the entire user. In this work, first the user answers (examinee answer) are matched with standard answers (examiner answer) using lexical similarity measure. In testing phase, five sets of question-answers have been considered where each set contains a single question from a subject domain and its five different answers. The system resolute an acceptable accuracy according to human decision. In the next phase of the work, both the answers have been compared using semantic similarity measure. In this phase, the synonymous words of the keywords from both the answers are retrieved from the semantic dictionary-WordNet to increase the needful and relevant overlap between the answers. Applying this semantic similarity measuring technique on the same question-answer sets, the accuracy of evaluation has been increased which is validated by an expert.

articleTitle: Web based Wi-Fi automated soil moisture controller
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: India is a land of agriculture. Three fourth of the Indian population depends on agriculture. Agriculture contributes to 16% of overall GDP and 10% of exports. In this paper, Web Based wi-fi automated soil moisture Controller is a setup based on Renesas microcontroller, GPRS module, Pulse Width Modulator (PWM), HTML page is used by the farmer to select the crop being cultivated and the system is made power independent using solar module. The most important feature of this system is continuous sensing of soil moisture content using moisture sensors. The sensed data is compared with the previously stored standard data for the particular crop in the main CPU and only the required amount of watesr is pumped using the system PWM. The pumped water is directed to the particular part of the land using electro-mechanical device, solenoid. Once the required moisture content is reached, the sensor sends the signal to turn off the motor through microcontroller. This conserves the water and supply only the required amount of water at the particular time. The aim of the project is to incorporate technology into the field of agriculture and let the farmer to irrigate large amount of land with optimum use of water.

articleTitle: Automation framework for test script generation for Android mobile
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: System testing involves activities such as requirement analysis, test case design, test case writing, test script development, test execution and test report preparation. Automating all these activities involves many challenges such as understanding scenarios, achieving test coverage, determining pass/fail criteria, scheduling tests, documenting result etc. A method to automate both test case and test script generation from Sequence diagram based scenarios is proposed. A tool is developed to convert UML Sequence diagram into Android APK to test Android mobile applications. A case study is done to illustrate this method. A detailed experimentation is done to study the effectiveness of this method. The comparative study with other methods shows this method is producing better results.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of video synopsis using online video inpainting
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Nowadays with a rapid growth of multimedia in-formation and advances in digital video technologies number of video captured is increasing day by day. The most of the recorded video which was generated is far more than the operators can watch, so identifying any interesting object or event has become very time consuming task, this kind of task might be feasible for some personal videos but this tedious task impossible when there will be endless video. So video synopsis acts as productive tool for indexing and browsing of such lengthy video. Video synopsis is a way of creating a compact representation of original video by presenting essential activities. In this paper video inpainting algorithm is proposed to generate video synopsis. Video inpainting is the method which aims to remove portion of video or object and restoring that missing portion by visually steady manner. In this paper video inpainting algorithm is implemented to inpaint the missing portion of a video sequences. This algorithm includes two stages one is simple processing and another one is video inpainting. In first stage foreground and background frame segmentation will be done. In second stage to inpaint the background objects image inpainting method and background replacement method will be used. To inpaint moving foreground objects background subtraction and object segmentation is used.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent and robotic library system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In the project we will demonstrate a design of intelligent robotic library system. In this system for intelligent operation is done by the programming in visual basics(VB) and Microsoft access is used for database, like to know information about user and books of library. In this system robotic arm is used for pick up and place the book with the help of sensors like barcode reader and IR sensor, RFID tag on book and RFID transmitter on ARM, motors for arm mobile base. However, for sending commands and data through GUI to the arduino controller of arm, processing software is used. For issuing and returning book another GUI is provided which we can use to check availability of books. After checking the book availability that book number is sent through zigbee or any wireless media from computer in library and received at robotic arm side. Every shelf and every book is having identification by using RFID tag and barcode. Once the book is passed through reader, the controller checks the received number from zigbee with number scanned by barcode reader. If both the numbers are matched then robotic arm will pick the book. If that book is not available then a notification is given to librarian system. After receiving that book it will place to library table.

articleTitle: C-dump converter for switched reluctance motor
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Switched reluctance motor have various converter topologies to control speed, power & its operation, this paper discusses the C-dump converter topology. The choice is based on the ease of control, simple construction, and low cost. The switched reluctance motor is best competitor for induction motor. Due to its low cost, rugged & simple construction, high torque to mass ratio Switched Reluctance Motor is preferred over Induction Motor. C-Dump converter provides the quick magnetization as well as the quick demagnetization of phase winding which prevents operation of motor in generating mode. It avoids formation of negative torque ripples. It also utilizes the energy stored in phase winding & it can be feedback to source. Some new modified converter topologies of C-Dump are capable of utilizing this stored energy for exiting the next phase winding of motor.

articleTitle: Dynamic error control scheme based on channel characteristics in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The application of wireless technology is increasingly influencing the deployment of sensor networks at low cost and maintainance. Poor channel conditions, severe power constraints, interference and low power communication requirements magnify the need for energy efficient and preferably cross layer error control schemes for Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). The main goal of error control mechanisms in WSNs is to reduce energy consumption while taking care of reliable and fast delivery of the sensed data. We propose a Dynamic Error Control Scheme based on Channel Characteristics in Wireless Sensor Networks (DECSCC) that estimates the channel errors and controls errors dynamically based on channel characteristics and noise power observed at the receiver. We have have come up with the models for both the error and channel estimation. Analysis of simulation results for various message sizes and error conditions show improvement in terms of throughput and the probability of retransmissions.

articleTitle: Rice quality analysis based on physical attributes using image processing technique
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This review paper is for quality control of rice which is most important crop for human as well as in food market using image processing techniques and computer vision. Basic problem in Indian food industry that performs quality check manually by human inspectors which is non-reliable, costly and time consuming.

articleTitle: Pedometric CAPTCHA for mobile Internet users
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: CAPTCHA requires proof of humanness, thus every CAPTCHA design strives to trace human skills in its user. Many human skills have been explored for designing robust CAPTCHA. In this paper we propose a novel CAPTCHA design for mobile devices. Proposed Pedometric CAPTCHA uses human capability of walking. This paper aims to provide algorithm for implementing Pedometric CAPTCHA, analyze its' usability for persons with various disabilities, perform security analysis and study of user experience. As attacks on CAPTCHA are performed by software bots, human capability of walking or creating acceleration in a mobile device can be effectively used to thwart bots. Usability analysis shows that Pedometric CAPTCHA is accessible for almost all types of disabilities except for the complete motor disability. Study of user experience depicts that 92.2% of the 64 volunteers found the Pedometric CAPTCHA interface to be easy to navigate.

Author Keywords: Completely Automatic Public Turing test to tell Computer and Human Apart (CAPTCHA)

articleTitle: Complete data and address generation for memory testing using modified LFSR structures
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: March-based algorithms are important in testing of memory cores especially in Memory BIST architectures as it provides good fault coverage. For Memory testing, we need test vectors and addressing sequences. Conventional methods use Linear Feedback Shift Register (LFSR) for generating test vectors and counter circuits for the address generation. With the modified LFSR structure we can replace the need for two circuits by a single circuit. This paper focuses on developing two structures; a Complete Linear Feedback Shift Register (CLFSR) and a Configurable CLFSR. Both are configured by modifying LFSR circuit. CLFSR can be used for the generation of both test vectors and addressing sequences. Hence it enables to replace LFSR and Counter circuits in a conventional Built-in Self-Test architecture by a single circuit. This reduces the complexity and hardware requirement of the architecture. It has been found that, two addressing orders are required to perform the memory test using March test algorithms. The proposed Configurable CLFSR provides the two addressing sequences for the March Test algorithms in a simple way with less hardware. The effectiveness of this architecture is evaluated by implementing it in March C-algorithm. Functional verifications and Simulations are done using Verilog HDL in Xilinx ISE 14.2.

Author Keywords: Configurable Complete Linear Feedback Shift Register

articleTitle: Design of multi-band rectangular patch antennas using defected ground structure (DGS)
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Small size, multi-band rectangular microstrip patch antennas using Defected Ground Structure (DGS) for Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN-5.8 GHz), Worldwide interoperability for Microwave Access (WiMAX-5.8 GHz), Airport Surveillance (2.7-2.9 GHz), and Direct Broadcast Satellite (DBS) Europe (10.7-12.75 GHz) are presented in this paper. A thorough study has been made into the different multiband applications of the antennas using various slots such as square slot, triangular slot etc. in the ground plane. The above mentioned DGS patterns are simple and easy to etch on a commercial microstrip patch antenna. These structures reduce the cross-polarized (XP) radiation field without affecting the dominant mode input impedance and co-polarized radiation patterns of a conventional antenna. This novel concept (DGS) has been examined using CST Microwave Studio software employing a rectangular patch as the radiator. The proposed antennas have shown good radiation characteristics at various operating bands, which make them suitable for multi-band operations.

articleTitle: Classification of diabetic patients records using Naïve Bayes classifier
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Classifying the diabetic patients records based on archieved data is one of the computational diagnosis method. In this paper we present the classification of diabetic patient records using pima Indian diabetes dataset available publically. We train the system using naïve Bayes classifier to classify patients into positive and negative classes. We present the difference in classification in accuracy with and without using the feature selection method.

articleTitle: Voice enabled gadget assistance system for physically challenged and old age people
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The paper develops device switching via voice commands. Therefore, the focus is on device switching and controlling Bluetooth modem to send SMS in case of emergency, all controlled by voice commands. To be specific, there are three main objectives in this project. First of all, to design and construct a voice enabled device switching system to assist physically challenged and elderly people. Secondly, to develop an android application for alerting in case of emergency and for mailing purpose with the help of voice recognition system. Finally, to provide a communication mechanism between the user and the predefined number through SMS messages via Bluetooth modem in case of emergencies. The method used during the development of the system involves use of renesas flash programmer, android 4.0 software programmer and RS232 serial port to receive and transmit data from a mobile phone.

articleTitle: Studies on relating to monitoring blood glucose levels using noninvasive optical methods
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: According to International Diabetes Federation (IDF), India has the largest number of diabetic patients of about 50.8 million and it can be expected that by 2030 it would rise to 89 million if current unhealthy lifestyle is continued. The current method which is widely used for measuring blood glucose levels involves needles for pricking which is painful and can cause discomfort to the patient. We aim at designing a cost-effective glucometer which non-invasively measures blood glucose level using optical methods with acceptable error. After comparison of different optical methods, Near Infrared (940nm) type of measurement in reflectance mode was selected. The device was calibrated using invasive values and regression analysis was carried out for error-reduction. Arduino UNO was used for programming to quantify the glucose levels according to different conditions.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of boundary scan testing of core logic on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Boundary Scan technique is one of the strategies of testing Integrated Circuits (ICs), wiring connections on printed circuit boards or sub-modules. The boundary scan circuitry is inserted at the inputs of ICs and testing is done by feeding test patterns. To overcome the drawbacks of primitive testing methods like in-circuit, functional testing techniques, a newer boundary scan technique is adopted in the proposed paper which reduces the testing time and cost. There is a need for low cost PCB test technology, which allows the miniaturization of PCBs with simple design rules [1]. The test patterns are stored in the input data register and are fed as inputs to the boundary scan cells. The test patterns are also fed to the core logic circuit that is being tested. The core part of the technique includes the design of main module called tap controller. JTAG TAP controllers have become a deliverance and control mechanism for Design for Test [2]. Its output is stored in the register and compared with the known value to conclude whether the IC is functioning properly or not. The effectiveness of this design is measured in terms of parameters such as area, power and the speed.

articleTitle: Single bit-line low power 9T static random access memory
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The Static random access memory (SRAM) design is demanding due to the variation of the process parameters with CMOS technology scaling. It becomes challenging because the stability, write ability and leakage power consumption should all be considered to provide an optimum performance. The proposed cell consumes 8.54% less power compared to double bit-line SRAM. The 2 bit-line scheme of SRAM has more dissipation of power due to the charging and discharging of complementary bit lines. This paper puts forth a single bit-line 9T SRAM design which consumes lower power and low leakage. It has a high read SNM with good static and dynamic read/write performance. Single bit-line approach leads to lower power consumption compared to the conventional 2 bit-line SRAMs. However, the access time for read and write operation is increased.

articleTitle: Design of frequency synthesizer for wireless communication
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Modems play a vital role in the field of communication, Suitable and stable carrier frequency is required for any efficient modulation process. This paper proposes a method of generating carrier frequencies by using the concept of phase locked loop (PLL). The proposed method is implemented using the synthesizer chip ADF4351 and PIC32 microcontroller. ADF4351 can generate frequencies of range 35MHz to 4.4 GHz with external loop filter and reference frequency along with additional features like generating stable frequency in fractional-N mode and integer-N mode, fast lock mode, mute mode. The proposed methodology has successfully been experimented and verified for the following frequencies with precision up to two decimal points: 1GHz, 1235.54MHz, 1500.25MH, 1700MHz, 1800.665MHz, and 1995.00MHz. The obtained frequency components of the signals are very useful in the field of military and commercial application.

articleTitle: Outer race bearing fault identification of induction motor based on stator current signature by wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents the results of laboratory work carried out for identifying the outer race bearing fault occurred in an induction motor. The knowledge about fault behavior of an induction motor is extremely important for overall operational life of the machine. The paper refers to spectral analysis of the motor stator current, which includes routine stator current, noise and specific fault current signature. Using separate healthy and faulty bearing on the machine, testing is carried out for obtaining set of healthy and faulty currents for different load conditions. The specific fault signature can be separated using feature extraction in time domain Wavelet and after getting spectral information using classification technique ANN fault is identified.

articleTitle: Roboic recognition for unstructered 2-D parts to pick and place objects
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Robot grasping of unstructured objects to pick and place in a home environment is a problem in autonomous assembly. Current investigation focus on technology related with machine vision for image manipulation. Desired grasping location is found out from 2-D vision by the bounding rectangle and bounding rectangle diagonal to calculate total number of pixel on parts. Various steps are adopted especially tools and built-in functions of LabVIEW for image acquisition, manipulations, and processing. These tools and functions helped us to create efficient algorithm for object recognition, grasping of sensitive and hard objects without fail. The system contains routine functions for database creation, learning, training, searching, monitoring, and controlling of autonomous mobile robot. Communication between hardware to software and viz versa are configured by VISA resource through COM port. Experiments analysis is done for evaluation of robot in real time.

articleTitle: Effect of image colourspace on performance of convolution neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Recently the term Deep Learning has been creating a lot of interest in the fields of Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing. And especially the Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) are giving state of art results in image recognition, scene understanding, object detection and image description etc. Generally in CNN the processing of images is done in RGB colourspace even though we have many other colourspaces available. In this paper we try to understand the effect of image colourspace on the performance of CNN models in recognizing the objects present in the image. We evaluate this on CIFAR10 dataset, by converting all the original RGB images into four other colourspaces like HLS, HSV, LUV, YUV etc. To compare results we have trained AlexNet with fixed set of parameters on all five colourspaces, including RGB. We have observed that LUV colourspace is the best alternative to RGB colourspace to use with CNN models with almost equal performance on the test set of CIFAR10 dataset. While YUV colourspace is the worst to use with CNN models.

articleTitle: Detection of malicious URLs in big data using RIPPER algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: 'Big Data' is the term that describes a large amount of datasets. Datasets like web logs, call records, medical records, military surveillance, photography archives, etc. are often so large and complex, and as the data is stored in Big Data in the form of both structured and unstructured therefore, big data cannot be processed using database queries like SQL queries. In big data, malicious URLs have become a station for internet criminal activities such as drive-by-download, information warfare, spamming and phishing. Malicious URLs detection techniques can be classified into Non-Machine Learning (e.g. blacklisting) and Machine learning approach (e.g. data mining techniques). Data mining helps in the analysis of large and complex datasets in order to detect common patterns or learn new things. Big data is the collection of large and complex datasets and the processing of these datasets can be done either by using tool like Hadoop or data mining algorithms. Data mining techniques can generate classification models which is used to manage data, modelling of data that helps to make prediction about whether it is malicious or legitimate. In this paper analysis of RIPPER i.e. JRip data mining algorithm has been done using WEKA tool. A training dataset of 6000 URLs has been made to train the JRip algorithm which is an implementation of RIPPER algorithm in WEKA. Training dataset will generate a model which is used to predict the testing dataset of 1050 URLs. Accuracy are calculated after testing process. Result shows JRip has an accuracy of 82%.

articleTitle: Real-time color classification of objects from video streams
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Real-time Color identification and differentiating those colors of a moving object from a live video is a fundamental step in many real-time applications such as video surveillance, bio-metric identification process, etc., Object Detection is based on two parameters such as Objective and Subjective dimensions. Where the object consists of attributes like color, texture, shape, size and scale, however the subjectivity is guided by the observation of the image interpreters. Due to brightness and contrast sometimes webcam can hardly detect the expected color of the objects and because of the similarity of tracking, environment background color and the color of objects gets unexpected pixel value. This project will aim to implement object detection and color classification in MATLAB GUI. Where the objects will be detected and the color of the object will be classified in a real world scenario for both still and real-time image. This task includes image segmentation process for still image, where only the color and the count of objects will be recognized from a still image. However, for live video processing the region of the object as well as the color of the object will be recognized.

articleTitle: Virtual inertia control for transient active power support from DFIG based wind electric system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of Virtual Inertia control in a DFIG based wind energy system for transient active power support to grid. Inertia required for the active power support is calculated from fundamental equations and are used as design values for the generator/turbine. The rotor is connected to a dc bus through a bi-directional ac-dc converter and on the ac side the frequency and voltage is varied as directed by a Virtual inertia controller. With the shaft speed and grid frequency as inputs the controller gives out the rotor injection frequency and voltage. The active power sharing across rotor and stator is facilitated by controlling the phase angle of the inverter pole voltage with respect to the rotor voltage. The entire system is executed in MATLAB/Simulink Model and its performance is evaluated under various wind speed conditions. At different wind speeds the inertial response and the statorrotor power sharing are presented for varying inverter phase angles. The power balance is verified in each case to validate the effectiveness of the proposed virtual inertial controller.

articleTitle: Evaluation and validation of problem solving and thinking skills based on student academic performance
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Engineering Companies today, along with technical knowledge of the subject, expect various skills to be present in a candidate when they go for external hiring. Highly skilled workers are replacing well educated people in the industries. This has forced Universities and colleges to move from a traditional way of imparting technical education to enhancing skills like problem solving and thinking skills. But such skills may be inherent among some students and may be lacking among others. Hence, there is a need of a model which can evaluate problem solving and thinking skills, so that students lacking the skill can be trained. This paper suggests a weighted score clustering model, which can evaluate problem solving skills in a student. The model can be used by universities to identify low skilled students, so that special skills training can be imparted to them. The paper also validates the model with the help of the student's Job placement record.

articleTitle: Implementation of modular multilevel inverter in local trains of Mumbai
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Presently DC traction system in Local Trains in Mumbai has been completely converted into AC system due to the various advantages of AC over DC. Due to the heavy load on the traction system and by using various power electronics devices the Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) is more in the traction system. Author has done the complete harmonic analysis to find the harmonic content in A.C The present Local trains in Mumbai are having capacitor bank to reduce the level of harmonic but it is found insufficient but if basic inverters are replaced by modified modular multilevel inverter the value of the THD can be reduced to the certain extent. In this paper MATLAB implementation of 5 level and 7 level has been done using PI controller. Phase disposition methods like PD, POD and APOD are used to find the performance of traction motor Harmonic analysis result is compared with the simulated results of modular multilevel inverter. This comparative study shows the benefits of using modular multilevel inverter as the harmonics values have been reduced.

articleTitle: Fuzzy maximum power point tracking algorithm for photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The maximum power point tracking is required to enhance the efficiency of the photovoltaic system. The traditional perturb and observe algorithm is common and generate the problems of oscillations at steady state condition. In this paper the intellegent fuzzy logic system is used to develop the maximum power point algorithm. The algorithm is simulated in the MATLAB/ Simulink environment and the results are compared with traditional perturb and observe algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation of optimized load balancing and user job scheduling using CloudSim
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Right from the invention of World Wide Web (WWW) by Tim Berners Lee, Internet became a platform that has highest impact on people of all walks of life. In fact the world is shrinking and became a small village and virtual platform without which individuals and businesses cannot be assumed now. Of later based on Internet a new technology known as cloud computing came into existence. Cloud computing is a new model of computing which helps haring pool of resources in pay per use fashion. The services it bestows include software, platform and infrastructure. Cloud data centres play a vital role in providing storage service to users. The huge computing resources provided by cloud service providers are to be utilized optimally in order to provide sustainable services to users. However, it is a challenging problem to be addressed. Load balancing is one of the techniques employed to optimize resource allocation and ensure high availability and performance of cloud computing. In this project cloud partitioning approach is extended for effective load balancing and resource optimization. Besides the ideal refresh period which determines changes in the state of partitions of data centre for optimized resource utilization. CloudSim is the simulation framework used to build a prototype application for demonstrating the proof of concept. Our results showed that the proposed solution improves performance, throughput and utilization of cloud resources.

articleTitle: Vehicle classification using compressive sensing
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Compressive Sensing has garnered lot of attention in the fields of Information technology & Signal Processing as it offers an alternate, redundancy-free approach to signal compression and reconstruction. It exploits the ‘sparsity’ of the signal to under-sample the sequence and reconstruct it without adding aliasing noise as established by Shannon-Nyquist sampling theorem. However, the methods of reconstruct are expensive due to the usage of non-linear reconstruction polynomials. This paper draws comparison between existing sparse signal recovery method, Compressed Sampling Matching Pursuit (CoSaMP), to Iterative Soft Thresholding algorithm (IST), and utilizes IST for classification of Vehicles with Acoustic signal source. The signals are sampled at half the Nyquist rate, followed by reconstruction using IST. Various features like mean, variance, skewness, and kurtosis of signal is extracted from multiple transform domains. The extracted features from the reconstructed signal is fed to K-NN classifier which classifies target signal as a bike, car, tractor, or a bus.

articleTitle: Skyhook control for active suspension system with a novel variable damper
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to achieve a better ride comfort and a good relative suspension travel within limits using an active suspension. This paper consists of an exponentially variable damper to achieve both above objectives. In fact, it is not possible to achieve both above parameters in a controlled manner simultaneously. The variable damper will help to achieve both the objective in a better way. The skyhook suspension results are analyzed on MATLAB-SIMULINK and compared with passive suspension. The results are validated on hardware.

articleTitle: Design of fault injection technique for VLSI digital circuits
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Development of VLSI technology has increased the design complexity on the IC chip. With this, the possibility of fault occurrence also has increased. In many of the mission critical applications, the reliability of the system is given a higher priority. In order to make a system reliable, fault tolerant techniques are included in most of the systems. Fault injection is an essential part of the fault tolerant system design. It includes processes of fault insertion and observation of system behaviour in presence of inserted faults. In this paper, an efficient fault injection method is proposed which aims at covering all possible fault occurrences with increased speed of fault injection. This method is applied for s27 circuit and Maximally Redundant signed Digit (MRSD) adder. The proposed technique is implemented using Xilinx 14.5 ISE tool.

articleTitle: Implementation of CELP encoder using Vivado HLS
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Eminent research scholars have confirmed the feasibility of CELP principle and its implementation which overcomes the hurdles of primitive algorithms like RELP, where in the residual signal information can't be reconstructed further, but which is possible in CELP implemented technique which produces good quality speech at low bit rates. This paper's central idea is the design and implementation of CELP encoder. This LPC technique achieves LP analysis of speech by extracting the LP parameters and coefficients and utilizes a scheme to search a codebook and compute the excitation signal. With the help of Vivado HLS we have implemented synthesizable set of codes and shown the report including timing, latency and hardware utilization.

articleTitle: Application of ANN and SVM for identification of tsunamigenic earthquakes from 3-component seismic data
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Two pattern classification methodologies - Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) have been used in this study to identify shallow focus (depth<;70 km) tsunamigenic earthquakes at a regional distance. Besides location and magnitude, the root mean square (rms) amplitudes of seismic phases recorded by a single 3-component station have been considered as inputs to both ANN and SVM. The trained ANN and SVM have been found to categorize 100% and 91% respectively of the new earthquakes successfully as tsunamigenic or non-tsunamigenic. Both the methodologies have been tested using three component broad band seismic data recorded at PALK (Pallekele, Sri Lanka) station provided by IRIS (Incorporated Research Institutes for Seismology) for earthquakes of magnitude 6.0 and above originating from Sumatra region. The fair agreement between the two methodologies ensures the existence of a single station based tsunami alert system which could be very useful for the poorly instrumented regions.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of enhancing of fringing field of CPW fed rectangular patch antenna for wireless communication
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper presents simulation of a multiband micro-strip antenna with a CPW feed to improve bandwidth and fringing properties like gain, directivity of the antenna for frequency range 10–70 GHz at simulation frequency 20 GHz. The various performance parameters are shown. The highest gain of 22.7 dB is obtained at 60.2GHz. The simulated model of antenna is ANSOFT HFSS 13.0. The comparative study of various structures is carried out to analyze the performance of antennas for better selection. The main objective is to enhance the performance of antenna parameter by making changes in the shape of patch.

articleTitle: Factors influencing customer satisfaction with usage of shopping apps in India
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Over the past few years, there has been a ongoing transformation in the customer purchase patterns from offline channels to online channels. With the growing use of smart devices, Apps are fast catching up as a preferred mode to conduct online shopping. From startup to MNC's, companies are mainly targeting Apps, and it is easy to track and analyze the marketing data to generate more revenue with the help of shopping apps. An important question to ask in this context - and the focus of this study - is what factors influence customer satisfaction with shopping Apps? The data for this study was collected from 167 people throughout India and analyzed by using STATA software (Ordered Logistic method). Our results show that Design aesthetics, Information quality and Image appealing all significantly influence customer's satisfaction with the usage of shopping apps in India.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of spatial interpolation methods of different field measurements for cognitive radio
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Spectrum has become one of the essential needs of living in the modern world. However, the emerging needs in wireless communications is making the spectrum congested, and hence there might be a scarcity of spectrum in future. Cognitive Radio (CR) is a niche technology to increase the effective utilization of spectrum by the opportunistic usage of idle spectrum resource dynamically. To evaluate different spatial interpolation techniques, the data used in this paper is from the field measurements from Wise-Project Measurement Report: “PMSE Protection Measurements in Helsinki City Theatre” and applied interpolation techniques in ARCGIS software such as Inverse Distance Weighting (IDW), Theissen or Voronoi interpolation, ordinary, universal and indicator kriging. Accuracy in estimation is measured using cross validation of root mean square error [RMSE], and it is used for the comparison of interpolation methods applied to the field measurement data.

articleTitle: Digital implementation of hyperbolic calculation unit for electronic cochlea on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Among the five sensory organ of human body ear is one of the most important. We cannot imagine a world without sound. But the truth is hearing loss is the third most reported disability. There are different types of deafness caused by several reasons. Normal hearing aids are not able to solve this problem completely because it only amplifies the sound. The cochlear implant is the only solution which is totally different from hearing aids. Cochlear implants compensate for damaged parts of ear. There are many such models developed in analog platform. They are less accurate when compare with biological cochlea. The model discussed in the paper is in digital platform. The model is multiplierless piecewise linear model 3(MLPWL 3), a modified version of MLPWL 1 and MLPWL 2. Hopf bifurcation basics are used for the design of the system. The aim of this work is to reduce the computational complexity and reduce the hardware cost. The model was simulated in MATLAB and the design was developed in verilog, simulated in modelsim and mapped on to FPGA using XILINX ISE 14.2. Mojo V3 development board is used for physical implementation.

articleTitle: Dynamic power optimization using look-ahead clock gating technique
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Main part of power dissipation in real time processors occurs due to dynamic power. Thus to reduce this in digital systems a technique namely clock gating is used. The three most popular techniques are latch-based, data-driven and Auto-Gated FF (AGFF) based clock gating. Here a combination of above techniques namely Look-Ahead Clock Gating (LACG) is presented. Problems such as timing and hardware overheads can be solved using LACG.

articleTitle: Implementation of stereo visual odometry estimation for ground vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Keeping track of vehicles location is a challenging aspect in recent days. Visual Odometry (VO) is the process of estimating the orientation and position of a vehicle or a robot by analyzing the associated camera's input. In this paper a stereo camera based visual odometry system is presented in which stereo cameras have been rigidly attached to the vehicle and motion of the vehicle is estimated using only the input coming from these stereo cameras. No other sensors are needed. The corner features are extracted in both left and right images using Harris corner detector algorithm, descriptor for each feature is extracted using Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) algorithm, feature descriptors are matched between left and right images using K-nearest neighbor match. Those matched feature correspondences are triangulated to get 3-D points. Two sets of 3-D points are obtained at time steps ‘t’ and ‘t+1’. Then, the motion is estimated using least squares fitting of these two 3-D point sets.

articleTitle: A smart adaptive LSTM technique for electrical load forecasting at source
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Electrical load forecasting has never been more critical, given its high influence on the operational efficiency of the power supply system. Accurate prediction helps in making decisions and has a huge impact on the revenue of the suppliers. However, the prediction is not trivial and has several hurdles such as the nonlinear property of the time series or the seasonality pattern that generally inherently exists in a time series problem. Several techniques have been proposed to solve this problem such as statistical models, fuzzy systems, artificial neural networks (ANNs) and machine learning. This paper aims to present a comparison between popular techniques used in this problem domain with a few novel techniques that predict the electrical load at source. Several characteristics of the time series have been analyzed in depth. All the models proposed here have been compared rigorously through several objective functions. The results show that the models proposed here outperforms several statistical and machine learning techniques that are used conventionally.

articleTitle: Signal processing system design for acoustic emission signatures detetction and analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Detecting acoustic emission signals are very important for analysis. In this paper we have proposed a hardware based portable, energy efficient and accurate acoustic emission signal acquisition system based on DSP processor, design of acoustic piezoelectric sensor and a signal conditioning unit with variable gain amplifier and wide band pass filter. Different signal conditioning unit design consideration and wavelet based signal denoising procedure is also discussed in this work. This work would be useful for hardware based signal acquisition system design.

articleTitle: Smart sensor using function approximation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper reports a neural network (NN) implementation of function approximation. Function approximation (aka, nonlinear regression) identifies input-output relationship from given input-output data set. Concept of function approximation is applied to develop a smart position sensor. Smart position sensor consists of three standard sensors that are coupled with a neural network to produce an estimate of the location of an object in one dimension. MATLAB is used to construct and train the multi layer feed forward neural network. Hardware implementation of trained neural network is done on Arduino Uno microcontroller board.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of area-delay-power efficient CSLA based 32-bit array multiplier
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Addition and Multiplication are two important mathematical operations that can be performed in every digital circuit. The performance of multiplier depends on adder, hence there is a need to use an efficient adder for multiplication. Definitely an efficient Adder can be utilized to enhance the performance of DSP system. This paper presents lower area, energy efficient 32-bit Array Multiplier based on optimized Carry Select Adder. The proposed Multiplier gives high performance by saving 41% power, less delay by 27% with less area by reducing the slices up to 11.83% and LUTs by 7.6% when compared to conventional CSLA based Array Multiplier.

articleTitle: Drone based image processing through feature extraction
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The method proposed in the paper is to build a drone with camera to capture images of crops, soils, flodded areas and those images are processed to get required results. Building of Drone is the first part. The Bag of Words algorithm is then applied on the test image and specific features areextracted. These features are matched against the features of images in the predefined data set. The data set has classified categories of different types of cropimages. After matching result is given as the name of the category to which the testimage belongs.

articleTitle: Optimization of hadoop small file storage using priority model
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The improvement in the technology and the desperate need to store huge data has been increasing steadily. Hadoop uses MapReduce framework for processing big datasets, which consists of namenode and datanode. The hadoop framework technology has been extensively used to store, process, and use the enormous data that are being placed into server. Handling of huge small files is becoming laborious since the namenode has to manage the filenames and its corresponding metadata. For the purpose of fault tolerance, the data needs to be replicated on the data nodes. In order to handle the mammoth number of small files and to reduce the out of memory burden on the namenode, several techniques are being approached which involves HDFS, EHDFS, SFS, HAR, NHAR. In this paper we discuss about the different techniques that are developed to handle the storage of small files and propose a new method to solve the storage issue in hadoop. The new method takes the priority of the file as a distinguishing factor which further helps in reducing the memory usage of namenode.

articleTitle: Heart disease monitoring system using contact measure of stability index
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The medical field in heart related issues and parameters are of utmost importance to man. It proposes heart beat monitoring system using ECG sensor. In order to record the electrical impulses through the heart muscle ECG is used. An android application is going to monitor the data coming from the ECG sensor and if it exceeds the maximum threshold value of heartbeat rate then it will generate an alert for the user and will send SMS to the mobile phone of the medical expert or health personnel. This system proposes real time, remote, safe and accurate monitoring of heartbeat rate, then it will generate alert for the user and will send SMS to the health personnel. A microcontroller is used in this system which is a single chip device in order to analyze heart rate in actual time and this complete system design is focused towards a microcontroller which is a single chip based system.

articleTitle: Neural network classification of EEG signal for the detection of seizure
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Brain is the strongest part of the human body which consists of the number of neurons. Electrical activity of the brain can be measured using many techniques in which EEG is widely used. Any change in electrical signal will define a particular abnormality in human. This paper, suggest a algorithm for the EEG signal analysis for the detection of seizure using wavelet transform and statistical parameters. Data set consists of two sampling rates, one with 128Hz and another with sampling rate of 1024Hz. Feature extraction was done using discrete wavelet transform. Once a feature extraction is done the data will be given to a neural network for the classification. A multilayered neural network was used classify seizure and normal person. The proposed algorithm is tested on 23 data sets. Classification accuracy of 100% has been achieved for the sampling rate of 1024 and 85% for the data with sampling rate of 128. Total system accuracy achieved is 92.5%.

articleTitle: Neural network control for power quality enhancement using dynamic voltage restorer
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Quality of power is decreasing day by day by use of semiconductor devices. Lack of power quality causes disturbance in the system. Power quality mainly depends upon quality of voltage. Sag, Swell and harmonics are main factor of voltage quality. Dynamic voltage restoration is a process and instrument necessity to maintain, or restore and also compensate functional electric load during disturbance in voltage supply like voltage sag, swell and harmonics. DVR is the most reliable custom power device that can protect sensitive load and it can be entirely resolve the power quality problem in distribution power generation. This paper describe the DVR system used to compensate the temporary voltage sags and harmonics, which last form 3s to 1min. the design and control methods of inverter have been maintain and substantiate MATLAB simulation model. Also in this model, neural network control system and PWM pulse is used.

articleTitle: Automated testing of the medical device
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Medical devices can be checked for efficiency and effectiveness using automated tests. A medical device generally consists of knobs, switches and pushbuttons to operate. While manual testing of the efficacy of the functioning associated with the switches is possible, its often not possible to stress the functionality by manual testing. Stress testing of the functionality associated with the knobs is possible by tapping into the electrical point receptive to the input action associated with the switch. The first part of automated testing is to automate the manual switches which are the part of medical device. These switches are used for rebooting, ventilating etc. This can be done by using software that assists programming switches that operate on electrical signals, like those offered by NI LabVIEW. The next part is to send the desired key presses from the computer to the device and then to verify whether the action corresponding to the keypress is executed. This can be done by using Python scripts. By automating, a couple of advantages are increased test efficiency, and a reliability statistic by way of the number of automated tests run before we see errors otherwise not seen during normal human operation.

articleTitle: Influence of temperature variations on radio frequency performance of PNIN gate all around tunnel-FET
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: This paper analyses the performance of n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> source pocket PIN gate all around tunnel field effect transistor (PNIN-GAA-TFET) at radio frequency over a wide range of temperatures. The results are compared with the conventional counterpart i.e. GAA-TFET. It is examined that by amalgamating an n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> source pocket at the tunneling junction on GAA-TFET, various RF performance metrics such as current gain, unilateral power gain, maximum stable power gain (G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">MS</sub>), maximum available power gain (G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">MA</sub>), maximum transducer power gain (G<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">MT</sub>) and admittance parameters have been considerably enhanced. Additionally, the temperature affectability over the various power gains, cut off frequency and maximum oscillations frequency reveals only a slight enhancement at elevated temperatures. Moreover, manifolds increase in cut-off frequency (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub>) and the maximum oscillation frequency (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">MAX</sub>) is acquired for PNIN-GAA-TFET in comparison to GAA-TFET. Thus, the analyzed results offer the opportunity for realizing the stability of PNIN-GAA-TFET for high-performance RF Wireless communication applications over a wide range of temperatures.

articleTitle: Real time face detection robot
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Face tracking in real-time is required for activity recognition, automotive safety, and for surveillance systems. For this Arduino is used along with the packages available in MATLAB using Kanade-Lucas-Tomasi (KLT) algorithm. However, due to more complex motion in real time, a better algorithm is required. In this paper, the entire process is divided into two steps: the face is detected by Viola-Jones detection algorithm and then the KLT algorithm is used to track the feature points in the video frame. Human faces are detected and tracked with the help of webcam and servo motors. Thus, an efficient, low cost, light weight programmable robot has been built.

articleTitle: Development of prototype for vehicle speed measurement
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Motion estimation and tracking are significant activities in many computer vision applications. Real-time surveillance is a vigorous element in any circumstances or environment where there is a great necessity of security for both personal and commercial property and assets. This paper aims to develop a prototype for measurement of vehicle speed. The vehicle speed is estimated using algorithm based on background modeling and blob detection. Absolute differencing method isolates foreground and background efficiently. The blob detection technique provides coordinates in the form of centroid resulting in the display of the vehicle movement. The performance of the system has been tested on videos captured on typical Indian highways using AXIS IP camera. Also, the algorithm is tested in the lab setup. A Raspberry Pi 3 processor and IP camera were used as hardware for this project. To overcome the shortcoming of formerly recommended methodologies, here vehicle speed estimation is done in Python using OpenCV. The speed is calculated by mathematical formulation based on the distance traversed by vehicle. The error in the speed estimation is observed to be 9 %.

articleTitle: Solar power forecasting analysis of trends in modeling techniques and error minimization mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The plant utilization factor of solar photovoltaic power in present context is poor. Unavailability of proper solar power forecasting being one of the reasons behind low plant utilization factor. Data survey has suggested that annual plant load factor in India has not breached 25 % mark. This paper is intended to compile and correlate the work done by more than 300 researchers in 100 published research paper for in the field of solar power forecasting and to highlight the best tools and techniques available to improve plant load factor.

articleTitle: A novel 8T SRAM with minimized power and delay
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel 8T SRAM cell is proposed which aims at decreasing the delay and lowering the total power consumption of the cell. The threshold voltage variations in the transistor affect the read and write stability of the cell. Also, power dissipation increases with the number of transistors which in turn affects the read and write stability. The proposed 8T SRAM bitcell is designed using 180 nm CMOS, n-well technology with a supply voltage of 1.8 V. The results show that the average delay has been improved by 80 % compared to the conventional 6T cell. The total power is improved by 14.5 % as compared to conventional 6T SRAM cell.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high efficiency vedic binary multiplier circuit based on squaring circuits
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Electronics, and in particular the integrated circuits has been made possible the design of powerful and flexible processors. Having this vision in mind, a dedicated architecture is proposed in this paper which is exclusively used for multiplication of two numbers based on the Vedic sutras. The most significant operation in any signal processing and scientific applications is multiplication. The use of squaring circuits in place of general multipliers can reduce the number of inputs and thereby significantly will reduce the area consumed. To accomplish this, we have implemented Nikhilam Sutra, which is one of the sixteen sutras in Vedic Mathematics. This is dedicated for computing the square of the number. This technique is further extended for finding the product of the binary numbers. The performance for the proposed design is compared with the existing multipliers, on the basis of delay and area utilization. The results prove that the architecture prosed using Nikhilam sutra improves the efficiency considerably. The design has been implemented using Verilog HDL for 8 bit numbers and the synthesis is done using Xilinx ISE 14.5 software.

articleTitle: Feature extraction using DPSO for medical image fusion based on NSCT
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Medical image fusion is a scheme of getting better toned image by coalescing dissimilar modes of images. In this work, a unique method of image fusion is suggested by combining Nonsubsampled Contourlet Transform (NSCT) decomposition through optimization algorithms. Relative analysis of feature extraction is achieved utilizing Darwinian Particle Swarm Optimization (DPSO) which are applied individually to input images and for output fused image to decrease the memory demand. Qualitative analysis is assessed on Entropy, Standard Deviation, PSNR, Average Difference and Cross Correlation. Experimental outcomes revealed that the non-objective standard of clinical images attained by employing DPSO method is superior to PSO.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high efficiency square root circuit using Vedic mathematics
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The essence of optimizing the VLSI design and improvising their efficiency is the key role in this generation. In this paper, a dedicated design architecture and algorithm is proposed exclusively for finding square root of a number. Finding square root is vital in probabilistic calculation, stochastic problems and communication, quite often iterative architecture is used. This redundant method increases area and power consumption, which also has comparatively higher time for computation. An ancient Vedic sutra, Dvanda yoga, dedicated for finding square root. We effectively used this principle and bestowed it for binary digits. The proposed architecture is compared with existing technique and square root finding circuits. We are using 32bits[16bits+16bits] floating binary input and 16bits[8bits+8bits] binary as output. Implementation is done using Verilog HDL, synthesis by Xilinx 14.5 software for SPARTAN-6. The cost of the algorithm is 360 LUTS, 235 slices and 159 slice flip flop with power consumption of 98.6mW. The proposed design uses shifter, adders and sub-tractor leading to low area and power optimization.

articleTitle: Tracking and emergency detection of inland vessel using GPS-GSM system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Tracking Inland Vessel in water is a challenging task, to avoid accidents due to route change. In this paper, a standard technology is considered, for tracking inland vessel so that the accidents in the sea can be avoided. A system is designed to detect and to constantly monitor the vessel and if the vessel is in danger an alert message can be sent to a rescue team by a base station where the vessel is been monitored. A Microcontroller 89s52, GPS, GSM, Ultrasonic Sensor, Vibration Sensor, Wireless Camera and RF Controllers are used to design this system. To provide communication GSM network is used and GPS is used to locate the vessel in the water. Vibration sensor is used to detect the vibrations within the water and Ultrasonic sensor is used to detect the object which is near to the vessel to avoid collision. Wireless Camera is linked between the base station and vessel and is used to continuously monitor the vessel. To provide communication between microcontroller and integrated devices to the Microcontroller Kiel Software is used and the prototype designed is tested.

articleTitle: A survey: Cursive handwriting recognition techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: In computer vision, recognition of cursive alphabets is a difficult and challenging task. Cursive alphabet recognition has its own importance within the field of bank cheques, American postcard, medical prescription letter, etc. The complexness of recognizing cursive alphabets lies within the stroke, inclination, size and the different handwriting styles. Here we have presented a survey on the recognition of cursive handwriting. Numerous methodologies are presented with their accuracy of recognition or recognition rate.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of human gesture recognition techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Today, a lot of research is being done in the area of human gesture recognition due to its various uses such as traffic management, surveillance, healthcare management etc. In this paper the performance of different filters, namely Gabor and Canny for edge detection during preprocessing of image sequences has been studied. Subsequently, the preprocessed images are used for human gesture recognition. The focus is mainly on two gestures-walk and bend. The different classifiers that are used are KNN (K-Nearest Neighbour), NN (Nearest Neighbour) and SVM (Support Vector Machine). The results are then compared for different training dataset sizes for each model. It is found that in general, the Gabor filter gave better results than the Canny edge detection method.

Index Terms: Pixels In The Region Of Interest

articleTitle: SIW based mono-pole antenna for WLAN and WIMAX applications
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: A rectangular mono-pole antenna is applicable to the wireless local area network (WLAN) and worldwide interoperability for microwave access (WIMAX) applications are suggested in this paper. The rectangular mono-pole of the planned antenna is created by substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) technique. The bottom rectangular patch resonates at around 5.8GHz. Reversed L-slot is depicting the antenna will operate at around 3.8GHz. At that point, with included top rectangular patch at their reverberation covering the 2.4GHz band. With the expansion of SIW strategy to this rectangular patch, change of return loss in the multiband reverberation, the antenna can cover the 2.4/5.2/5.8GHz WLAN and 2.5/3.5/5.5 GHz WIIMAX bands with an extremely minimized size of just 12.9×6.5mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Monopole antenna with omnidirectional radiation pattern, acceptable gain and efficiency has been obtained.

articleTitle: Digital image processing through parallel computing in single-core and multi-core systems using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Matlab by default is a single threaded application. so the single thread uses just one core irrespective of how many cores are available to run any simulation. Data analysis and visualization tool which has been designed with powerful support for matrices and matrix operations. when we talk here about digital image processing we basically refer to how we change the nature of the image either to improve its pictorial representation for better human understanding or to more suitable for machine interpretation. huge matrix calculations take place in matrix pixels, all these calculations are done in single core. here, we talk about three major digital image processing features provided by Matlab and how parallel computing feature provided by matlab helps its computational speed by decreasing the time of it execution. we compare matlab's performance on different systems using different number of cores. Overall the parallel computing tool in matlab helps in solving computationally intensive and data-intensive problems with much more ease and efficiency with regards to time.

articleTitle: Exploring the potential of a multi channel sequencer (MCS) in a next generation GTM-IP using virtual prototypes
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: The vehicle functions are increasing exponentially. To handle such complex requirements the amount of software and hardware components are getting increased. As a result new automotive IP's are evolving specifically to meet hard real time constraints. One such IP designed by Bosch is the Generic Timer module (GTM). In this paper we will explore the multi-channel sequencer (MCS) module of a next generation GTM-IP to offload the main CPU and accelerate the software algorithms, thus improving performance of the system.

articleTitle: IoT based application for e-health an improvisation for lateral rotation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) has penetrated into our day-to-day activities in one way or the other. IoT application provides a huge opportunity for applications in health care system, improving patients' quality of life. The combination of embedded systems, sensors and actuators associated with constant monitoring of patients aids in alleviating patient discomfort, providing timely assistance and supervision. IoT has a vast scope in health care system due to affordability and possibility to develop compact systems. In this paper, we propose an IoT based solution that can be adapted into Lateral Rotation Mattress used for bed-bound patients through embedding sensors to recognize patient discomfort and alleviate it through an intelligent IoT system.

articleTitle: Simulation of BPSK Costas loop for optical inter satellite link
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: With the development of high resolution cameras for Earth observation applications, there is increasing demand on a high data rate Satellite communication link. Free Space Optical (FSO) communication is a suitable candidate for such high data rate communication and offers several advantages. An Inter-Satellite link (ISL) utilizing the BPSK modulated optical link provides a viable solution to such challenge. Furthermore, homodyne coherent reception of BPSK modulated optical link provides the best receiver sensitivity when compared to any other modulation schemes. In view of this, simulation and analysis of optical carrier recovery using optical Costas loop for homodyne BPSK receiver is carried out using MATLAB Simulink software.

articleTitle: A survey of different image processing methods for the design and development of an efficient traffic sign board recognition system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: As far as the safety of a driver is concerned, more focus should be put on correct interpretation and information which is conveyed by a traffic sign, while driving a vehicle along the road. A sign board can be thought of as an emblem which disseminates important and meaningful information regarding the potential hazards prevailing among road users comprising roadways cladded with snowfall, construction worksites or repairing of roads taking place and telling the people to follow an alternative route. It alerts the person who is passing through the road about the maximum possible extremity that his vehicle is trying to achieve indicating slowing down the speed of vehicle since chances of having collision cannot be ruled out. The traffic sign images were acquired from the image database and were subjected to some pre-processing techniques such as conversion of original into gray scale images, filtering the images with the help of Averaging Filter, Wiener Filter, carrying out the operation of Unsharp Mask Filtering which consists of performing the conventional method of Unsharp Mask Filtering as well as controlling the amount of sharpness with the help of certain parameters. In the future, we will concentrate on detecting, recognizing as well as classifying a particular sign board.

articleTitle: A smart water utilization technique based on voltammetric electronic tongues for domestic and industrial environment
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd IEEE International Conference on Recent Trends in Electronics, Information & Communication Technology (RTEICT)
abstract: Water is the essence of life and so it enables life on the earth. Today, we are living in the world where clean water is increasingly scarce and it needs to be conserved. The water usage has increased tremendously throughout the globe. The amount of water available per head has decreased globally. So, the access to clean drinking water available per capita has gone down. There are various modern and traditional approaches employed to enhance the water management. Reuse of water is an example that has served as an essential water resource management. This research paper focuses on the reuse of the greywater in the houses using an electromechanical system. The proposed work employing a pH sensor and particulate sensor that operates the Electro-mechanical System comprising of Motor and flaps for the diversion of water. The motor facilitates the opening of appropriate flaps in the system. Using the pH sensor and particulate sensor in conjunction with water separation mechanism, considerable amount of water can be saved for other purposes. After sensing of chemical (pH) and the solid particles (particulate sensor), water can be diverted to the sewer line or not, and after passing both the tests, water can be reused. The system with proper positioning of the flaps, operated by the electro-mechanical system can accomplish this separation. The electromechanical system receives its input from the sensors. Precise 90 degrees of rotation of the motor shaft and the linkages to operate the flaps is accomplished by using embedded system. The two flaps which are positioned inside of the Y joint, one opens the recycle tank and the sewage tank. The whole process is analyzed, experimentally tested and modelled from the view point of informatics, simulations and optimized before the final implementation of the work.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of compact digital phase shifter using substrate integrated waveguide
